analyzed_vuln.description: `VariadicFormatParams` unconditionally constructs and passes `m_data`, whose type is `Array<TypeErasedParameter, sizeof...(Parameters)>`. For a formatting call with no parameters, this becomes `Array<TypeErasedParameter, 0>`; AK::Array uses a zero-length C array member, so `m_data` occupies no valid object storage and `this->set_parameters(m_data)` performs a member call/conversion on an address with insufficient space. In this PoV the operation is inlined into `handle_color_transform()` at its zero-argument `dbgln("YCCK isn't supported yet")` call.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A JPEG must parse successfully through an APP14 `Adobe` marker whose transform byte is 2 (`YCCK`) and then reach image decoding/color transformation. The PoV supplies that APP14 segment, a parser-accepted one-component SOF (the inconsistent short SOF length is not enforced), and an immediate EOI, so `construct_macroblocks()` returns and `handle_color_transform()` selects the YCCK branch. Its literal-only `dbgln` instantiates `VariadicFormatParams<..., /* no Parameters */>`, triggering the invalid zero-sized `Array` access. No specific pixel/Huffman data is required.
